description: Tracked competitors used in share-of-voice and visibility comparisons, with each one's other names and sites, AI visibility score, citations of checks over the last 30 days, win rate (the share of its last 30 days' answers that name it first among the brands they name), domain metrics and positioning analysis. Also returns you: the workspace's own win rate.

engines.description: Only these engines' answers: their ids, comma-separated (chatgpt, perplexity, claude, gemini, grok, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview). Leave it out for all seven.

topic.description: One topic's questions only: its id or name from get_topics, or none for questions with no topic. Leave it out for the whole workspace.

name: get_competitors
